# Bundled fonts

Latin-subset variable WOFF2 files from Google Fonts (fetched 2026-10-11), loaded with `next/font/local` in `../layout.tsx` so `next build` never downloads fonts:

- `Karla-Variable-latin.woff2` — Karla, © The Karla Project Authors
- `Newsreader-Variable-latin.woff2` — Newsreader, © The Newsreader Project Authors

Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org), which permits bundling and redistribution with software.
